headerDisplay: Opens Intratone / Cogelec doors from HomeKit. Run this plugin as a **child bridge**. If the mobipass key is held by another phone, transfer it with `homebridge-intratone activate` then `homebridge-intratone verify --otp <code>` (see README).

app_id.title: App ID
app_id.description: Application id embedded in the official Intratone app.

app_token.title: App token
app_token.description: Application token embedded in the official Intratone app.

tel.title: Phone number
tel.description: Phone number tied to the Intratone account, e.g. 0612345678.

device_id.title: Device ID
device_id.description: Leave empty to generate one and keep it forever. To reuse an existing phone's registration, paste its device_id (found in its JWT).

service.title: HomeKit service
service.description: HomeKit only. Over Matter every door is a door lock.

pulse_seconds.title: Pulse duration (s)
pulse_seconds.description: How long the door shows as unlocked/open after a successful command.

access_refresh_minutes.title: Access list refresh (min)
access_refresh_minutes.description: How often the list of doors is re-fetched to add or remove accessories.

app_version.title: App version sent to the server

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Logs request/response bodies (tokens masked) at info level.
